pirati: Original pirate adventure. The people wear a simple pirate vest and belt, no hat, no bandana. Behind them: a wooden sailing ship with big sails, ocean waves, a treasure chest with coins, a palm island in the distance, seagulls. A friendly parrot sits on a rope or a chest, not on their heads.
unicorni: Enchanted unicorn meadow. The people wear simple fairytale tunics, no crowns, no flower wreaths. A cute original unicorn with a long wavy mane and a spiral horn stands beside them. Rainbow arch, fluffy clouds, flowers, butterflies, small star sparkles, a little crystal castle on a hill.
draghi: Original dragon kingdom. The people wear simple medieval adventurer clothes with a cape, no helmet, no hat. A big friendly dragon with large wings, horns and a long curled tail sits beside them. Mountains, a stone castle on a cliff, a cave with a few gems, pine trees, clouds.
spazio: Space adventure. The people wear simple astronaut suits, with no helmet on their heads (helmets floating nearby or held under the arm). A rocket, planets with rings and craters, stars, a small friendly alien, a moon surface, a satellite.
dinosauri: Prehistoric jungle. The people wear simple explorer vests, no hats. A friendly long-necked dinosaur, a baby triceratops and a cute small T-rex-like dinosaur stand near them. Giant ferns, palm trees, a smoking volcano in the distance, big leaves, eggs in a nest.
principessa: Fairytale kingdom. The people wear simple royal outfits (flowing gown or cape), no crown, no tiara, no veil. A tall castle with flags, a flower garden, a carriage, a small friendly horse, a fountain, butterflies.
